title_en: Fall 2026 Master's Thesis Examination: Schedule, Results Report and Thesis Submission
summary: Master's students in the Department of Aerospace Engineering taking the Fall 2026 thesis examination must give their thesis to each examination committee member at least 7 days before their examination and present at their scheduled time on December 10, 11, 16, 17 or 22. They must submit the examination results report to the department office by Tuesday, December 29, 2026. They must then submit the thesis PDF online through the Central Library website, and the online submission confirmation and the original approval page to the department office (Room 117), between January 15 and February 1, 2027, 14:00.
applies_to: Master's degree students in the Department of Aerospace Engineering who are taking the master's thesis examination in Fall 2026 (the 2nd semester of 2026). The examination, results report and thesis submission are required: students who do not submit the thesis cannot receive the degree and are excluded from degree conferral.

conditions: Each examination lasts 30 minutes per student: a 20-minute presentation and a 10-minute oral examination.
The thesis must be reviewed by your advisor before you give it to the committee members, and it must not be revised after submission.
Your presentation must not exceed 20 minutes.
Under the department rules, the thesis must in principle be written and presented in English.
The thesis PDF cannot be submitted without an approval page bearing the seal (stamp) or signature of every committee member, which you must obtain personally.
The thesis title and thesis language written in the examination results documents become the final thesis title and language and cannot be changed later.
Only the online PDF file is submitted; no bound (printed) thesis is submitted.
No submission or revision is possible after the online submission deadline.
If you do not submit the thesis, you cannot receive the degree; students who do not submit are excluded from degree conferral.
The online submission confirmation can be printed only after the PDF file has been submitted, and only after any unreturned library books and overdue fines have been fully settled.
Submission by a proxy is allowed only if formal requirements are met (approval page, consent form, etc.).
You must check your English name on the university portal, because it is used for the diploma.
steps: Read the attachments: the master's thesis examination presentation schedule (dated 2026.11.10), the thesis examination summary form, the cover and approval page sample, and the thesis writing guidelines and format. These attachments were not read for this translation.
Check your own examination date and time in the presentation schedule attachment.
Have your advisor review your thesis, then give the thesis for examination directly to each committee member at least 7 days before your examination.
Prepare your presentation (PPT file) and your own laptop, and test them in the examination room in advance to make sure there are no problems.
On your examination day, arrive and wait at least 20 minutes before your examination time, start your presentation when called, and keep it within 20 minutes.

Fill in the thesis title and your personal details on the master's thesis examination summary form (석사학위논문심사요지, attachment) and submit it as the results report to the department office (Room 117) by Tuesday, December 29, 2026.
Prepare the approval page (인준지, attachment) dated December 2026 at the top ("Submitted") and bottom ("Approved"), and personally obtain the seal (stamp) or signature of every committee member.
Check your English name on the SNU portal (http://my.snu.ac.kr) → Student Administration (학생행정) → Personal Information (개인정보) → Edit Basic Personal Details (기본인적 수정) and correct it if needed.

Prepare the final thesis according to the thesis writing guidelines and format (attachment), and read the separate notice on the submission method and the Central Library's official guidance when they are issued.

Between January 15, 2027 and February 1, 2027, 14:00, submit the thesis PDF file online at the Central Library website (http://library.snu.ac.kr) → Library Services (도서관서비스) → Online Thesis Submission (학위논문 온라인 제출).

After submitting the PDF, settle any unreturned books or overdue fines, then print the online thesis submission confirmation from the Central Library website → Library Services (도서관서비스) → Online Thesis Submission (학위논문온라인제출) → Resources (자료실).
Submit the online thesis submission confirmation and the original approval page to the department office (Room 117) by February 1, 2027, 14:00.
translation:
Fall 2026 Master's Thesis Examination Notice (Results report due by Tuesday, December 29)

This is the schedule for the Fall 2026 master's thesis examination in the Department of Aerospace Engineering.

[Master's Thesis Examination]

1. Examination schedule and individual schedules
- The examinations are scheduled for Thursday, December 10; Friday, December 11; Wednesday, December 16; Thursday, December 17; and Tuesday, December 22.

2. Format: 30 minutes per student (20-minute presentation / 10-minute oral examination).

3. Submission of examination materials
- Give the thesis for examination directly to the examination committee members at least 7 days before the examination.
※ Caution: Have your advisor review the thesis before submitting it, and do not revise it after submission.

4. Presentation
- Prepare your own presentation file (PPT) for the day (set up on your own laptop), and test it in the examination room in advance to make sure there are no problems.
- Check your examination time in the schedule, arrive and wait at least 20 minutes before your examination time, and begin your presentation when it is your turn.
- The presentation must not exceed 20 minutes.
- In principle, the thesis must be presented and written in English (department rules).

5. Submission of examination results
- Fill in the title and your personal details on the Master's Thesis Examination Summary form (석사학위논문심사요지) <attachment> and submit the results report to the department office by Tuesday, December 29, 2026.
※ When submitting the thesis (PDF file), it must include an approval page (인준지) bearing the seal (stamp) or signature of every committee member. Therefore, before submitting the thesis, prepare the approval page <attachment> and personally obtain the seals or signatures of the committee members.
※ The thesis title and thesis language in the examination results documents become the final thesis title and cannot be changed later.
※ Dates on the approval page: top part ("Submitted." / December 2026), bottom part ("Approved." / December 2026).

6. Submission of the thesis (archival copy)
1) Submission guidelines: follow the Thesis Writing Guidelines and Format; see <attachment>.
2) Online submission of the thesis (PDF file): Friday, January 15, 2027 to Monday, February 1, 2027, 14:00
- Submit only the PDF file online; no bound thesis is submitted.
- Central Library website (http://library.snu.ac.kr) → "Library Services" (도서관서비스) → "Online Thesis Submission" (학위논문 온라인 제출)
- Submission enquiries: Central Library Digital Services Office (contact details are in the original notice).
- No submission or revision is possible after the deadline.
- If you do not submit the thesis, you cannot receive the degree.
3) The submission method and other details will be announced separately later.
4) Submission of the online thesis submission confirmation and the original approval page
- Submission period and place: Friday, January 15, 2027 to Monday, February 1, 2027, by 14:00, to the department office (Room 117).
- How to obtain the online thesis submission confirmation:
* Print it yourself: Central Library website (http://library.snu.ac.kr) → "Library Services" (도서관서비스) → "Online Thesis Submission" (학위논문온라인제출) → "Resources" (자료실) (after submitting the PDF file).
* If you have unreturned books or overdue fines, you can print it only after paying them in full.
5) Other
- Action for those who do not submit: excluded from degree conferral.
- Submission by a proxy is possible, but formal requirements must be met (approval page, consent form, etc.).
- The thesis title and thesis language must be those written when the thesis examination results documents were submitted (no changes afterwards).
- For the issuance of the diploma, you must check your English name on the portal.
* How to enter or correct it: SNU portal (http://my.snu.ac.kr) → Student Administration (학생행정) → Personal Information (개인정보) → Edit Basic Personal Details (기본인적 수정) (enter and correct English name).
- Detailed guidance on thesis submission will follow the Central Library's separate official notice; please refer to the Central Library website.
* Follow the "Thesis Writing Guidelines and Format" (학위 논문 작성 요령 및 양식); see <attachment>.

[Submission of thesis examination results documents] By Tuesday, December 29, 2026
[Online submission of the PDF file to the library] Friday, January 15, 2027 to Monday, February 1, 2027, 14:00
[Enquiries] Department administrative office (contact details are in the original notice).
